summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Mayfair Gold Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting final results from its grade control drilling program at the Fenn-Gib Project. The program tested ~1M tonnes of probable mineral reserves, confirming model accuracy with 2% more tonnes at similar grade above 0.8 g/t Au cut-off, and 28% more tonnes at 7% higher grade above 3.0 g/t Au. The disclosure is operational, not a transaction; it validates reserve estimates and de-risks early cash flows but does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation. No deal terms or board actions beyond routine reporting exist.
